purpose: Screenshot-backed alignment between BI official collage UI objects and the real visible UI. This is domain discovery data, not testcase oracle data and not executable helper code.
policy: Confirmed means the object is visible in the referenced screenshots and its semantics match the domain object id.
Inferred from same surface means the surrounding component is captured but the exact state or child control is not directly visible.
Not captured means the object may exist, but the current screenshot set does not prove it.
Visual mismatch needs review means Codex found a likely naming or semantic mismatch; do not delete or rename without Tommy confirmation.

Known product gap means Tommy confirmed the expected UI object or interaction is currently missing or broken in the product; runtime should treat real interaction evidence as product FAIL when the testcase targets that frontend behavior.
